movie.title: Welcome Home Baby
movie.overview: Judith works as an emergency doctor in Berlin. When she inherits a house in Austria from the family who gave her away as a child, her quest to solve the mystery of her origins turns into a nightmarish journey into the past and the dark places of her soul.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a Berlin emergency doctor inherits a mysterious house in Austria from her biological family, her search for the truth about her past plunges her into a psychological nightmare.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Judith leads a busy life working as an emergency physician in Berlin, largely disconnected from her origins. Her routine is shattered when she receives news that she has inherited a house in Austria from the biological family who abandoned her as a child. Driven by a desire to finally uncover the truth behind her adoption, she travels to the remote property to investigate her roots. However, her quest for answers quickly turns terrifying as the house reveals horrific secrets, turning her journey into a dark confrontation with her past.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Judith is a dedicated emergency doctor living in Berlin, but her controlled life is upended by unexpected news from Austria. She discovers that she has inherited a quiet, secluded house from the biological parents who gave her up for adoption when she was a young child. Seeking resolution to the lifelong mystery of her origins, Judith decides to travel to Austria to inspect the property and uncover the story of her birth family. Upon arrival, the quiet countryside atmosphere quickly turns oppressive, and the house itself seems steeped in unsettling history. As Judith explores the home, she encounters disturbing clues and eerie occurrences that challenge her sense of reality. Her investigation unravels uncomfortable truths about her lineage, revealing that her abandonment was tied to something far more sinister than simple circumstance. Suspicion and paranoia take hold as she realizes the locals and the property hold deep-seated secrets meant to stay hidden. The boundary between external threats and her own internal trauma begins to blur, transforming her search for answers into a nightmarish fight for sanity. Ultimately, Judith is forced to venture into the darkest places of her own soul as she confronts the horrific legacy left behind by her family.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Judith is an emergency doctor in Berlin whose life takes a unsettling turn when she learns she has inherited a house in Austria from the biological family who gave her away as a child. Driven to solve the mystery of her origins, Judith travels to the remote Austrian property, hoping to find closure. Instead, her search for the truth unravels a haunting sequence of events that pushes her into a deep nightmarish journey into her past and the darker corners of her soul.
